rows.vgi.doc_md:
# vgi-boj

Discover Bank of Japan statistical series and retrieve observations with original periods, units and source metadata. The upstream public data service needs no API key. SQL NULL arguments are rejected; missing source values become NULL. Use function arguments for source filtering; SQL WHERE filters are local. HTTP worker access can require a bearer token.

Queries use bounded HTTP responses and retries. Credentials stay out of continuation state. See README.md for deployment and operational limits.
